news.headline: mRNA melanoma vaccine hits its Phase 3 goal
news.summary: First positive Phase 3 for a personalized cancer vaccine — Moderna/Merck's intismeran + Keytruda cut recurrence/death risk in high-risk melanoma. Her patients will ask; it's her exact lane.
news.her_angle: Reassure: this is adjuvant therapy for high-risk/resected melanoma, still investigational — not a shot that replaces sunscreen or skin checks. Early detection still wins.
